apiVersion: batch/v1
kind: Job
metadata:
  name: maskrcnn-image-seg
spec:
  template:
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: image-seg
        image: centaurusinfra/test1_maskrcnn:stable
        command:
        - python
        args:
        - -m
        - torch.distributed.launch
        - --nproc_per_node
        - '2'
        - tools/train_net.py
        - --config-file
        - configs/e2e_mask_rcnn_R_50_FPN_1x.yaml
        - --max_steps
        - '100'
        - OUTPUT_DIR
        - /results
        resources:
          limits:
            nvidia.com/gpu: 2
            cpu: 500m
            memory: 256Mi
          requests:
            cpu: 100m
            memory: 128Mi
        volumeMounts:
        - mountPath: /datasets/data
          name: remote-data
        - mountPath: /results
          name: remote-results
        - mountPath: /dev/shm
          name: dshm
        securityContext:
          capabilities:
            drop:
            - ALL
            - NET_RAW
            - NET_ADMIN
            - SYS_ADMIN
            - SYS_MODULE
            - SYS_PTRACE
            - SYS_CHROOT
          privileged: false
          allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
          runAsNonRoot: true
          readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
      volumes:
      - name: remote-data
        emptyDir: {}
      - name: remote-results
        emptyDir: {}
      - name: dshm
        emptyDir:
          medium: Memory
      restartPolicy: OnFailure
